blocks.item: Go to Policies > Access Control > Clientless > Privileged Credentials.
Name: Enter a name for the privileged credential. The name cannot contain special characters, with the exception of periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores ( _ ).
Description: (Optional) The description for the privileged credential.
Credential Type: Select one of the following options:
Username+Password: Select if you are using an RDP protocol.
Username: Enter the username for the login you want to use for the privileged credential.
Password: Enter the password associated with the username for the login you want to use for the privileged credential.

Domain: (Optional) Enter the domain name associated with the username. You can also include the domain name as part of the username. The domain name only needs to be specified when logging in to an RDP console that is connected to an Active Directory domain.
SSH Key: Select if you are using an SSH protocol.
Username: Enter the username for the login you want to use for the privileged credential.
SSH Key: Enter the SSH private key associated with the username for the login you want to use for the privileged credential. You can only use SSH private keys that are 2048-bit length or smaller.
Passphrase: (Optional) Enter the password that is used to protect the SSH private key.
Password: Select if you are using a VNC or RealVNC protocol. Enter the password for the login you want to use for the privileged credential.

blocks.text: You cannot change the Credential Type after it's been created and saved.

blocks.item: Credential Pool: (Optional) Select a credential pool if you want to assign the privileged credential to a specific pool.
